# Vendor icons

The icons in `aws/`, `azure/` and `gcp/` are a selection of the official architecture icons of
Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud. They remain the property of their owners
and are used under the terms published with each icon set:

- AWS: https://aws.amazon.com/architecture/icons/
- Azure: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/architecture/icons/
- Google Cloud: https://cloud.google.com/icons

They are generated, not edited by hand: run `scripts/build-icons.py` on the downloaded packs.
The original generic glyphs of tf2report live in `../` and are unrelated to these files.
